get.description:
Server-Sent Events: `state` when the job is queued or starts, `progress` while it runs (fraction, step, ETA),
then `done`, `error` or `cancelled` with the whole job, and the stream ends. An event's id is the job's version
(+1 at every change of its row), so a reconnect with Last-Event-ID gets the job's latest state only if it changed
since; the last event always comes.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: null for the system (a command, a migration, a schedule)

before_hash.title: Before Hash
before_hash.description: sha256 of the state before the write, when there was one

next.title: Next
next.description: the `before` of the next page, or null on the last one

state.title: State
state.description: cancelled at once when it was queued; running until it stops at its next batch

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: group of underlyings -> size bands -> lines (structured/defaults)

text.title: Text
text.description: pasted or CSV dates and levels

real_spot.title: Real Spot
real_spot.description: the real spot of the market's model level 100

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: fraction done, while running and at the end

eta.title: Eta
eta.description: seconds left, estimated from the progress so far (null early on)

elapsed.title: Elapsed
elapsed.description: seconds since the job started (0 while queued)

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: the Monte Carlo engine the worker ran it on

version.title: Version
version.description: +1 at every change: the id of its SSE events

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: follow it on GET /jobs/{job_id} or GET /jobs/{job_id}/events

reused.title: Reused
reused.description: an existing job was given back: the same Idempotency-Key, or the same request still queued or running

JobResult.title: JobResult
JobResult.description:
Every job result (api.md §5): the market, the method, and the result, whose Monte Carlo numbers are
`{value, se}`.

everywhere.title: Everywhere
everywhere.description: end every session of this user, on every browser

snapshot_id.title: Snapshot Id
snapshot_id.description: the stored snapshot the job priced on (null: none, e.g. a fit)

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: how much of that market was observed

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: the operation ids this user may call

csrf_token.title: Csrf Token
csrf_token.description: send it back in X-CSRF-Token on every state-changing request

Method.title: Method
Method.description: How a result was computed: `name` (monte_carlo, replication, full_revaluation, ...) and its parameters.

names.title: Names
names.description: name -> {vol, q, r}, flat markets rescaled to 100

next.title: Next
next.description: the cursor of the next page, or null on the last one

params.title: Params
params.description: the job's parameters (keys checked against the schedule's kind)

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: signed: > 0 when the book holds the investor side

TradeUpdate.title: TradeUpdate
TradeUpdate.description: What an edit may change; every edit is a new version of the trade.

field.description: dotted path of the field at fault (coupon.barrier)

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details; other members may follow (the term-sheet form adds its form)

Estimate.description: every Monte Carlo number of a job result: its value and its standard error (null when the library gives none)

csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrf.description: the csrf_token of POST /auth/login or GET /auth/me, on every state-changing request
